storylines.title: Democrats post a sweeping 2026 midterm result
storylines.detail: Democrats won the national House vote by 12.3 points and made broad gains in statewide races, while Florida remained a notable Republican outlier. The forecast retains a modest Democratic national shift and a small Florida-specific adjustment rather than treating the midterms as a direct forecast of 2028.

storylines.title: The fundamentals point in different directions
storylines.detail: Presidential net approval is -23.7 and the economy index is -1.41, with real-wage growth negative. The forecast leaves its economic input unchanged, while the overall fundamentals still favor Democrats.

storylines.title: The Democratic primary remains wide open
storylines.detail: Harris leads the broader polling average, while recent polls show varied support across the field. Whitmer has left a possible run open, but without primary polling or a decision to run, the forecast assigns her only a small chance and retains substantial probability on Other.

storylines.title: Shapiro's reelection and groundwork strengthen his case
storylines.detail: Shapiro's reelection, landslide margin, and federal PAC have drawn attention to a possible 2028 run. Recent coverage of his post-election groundwork supports the nomination chance already reflected in the forecast.

storylines.title: Ossoff's reelection fuels speculation despite his stated plans
storylines.detail: Ossoff's Georgia victory has renewed presidential speculation, and a recent primary poll placed him near the top of the field. He said in October that he would not run in 2028, so the forecast continues to give that possibility limited weight.

storylines.title: Vance and DeSantis position themselves for the GOP nomination
storylines.detail: Vance leads Republican primary polling and has taken steps toward a 2028 bid, while new reports say DeSantis is planning another White House run. Rubio has denied plans to leave the administration to run, and the forecast keeps substantial probability on the wider field.

storylines.title: Wes Moore enters the post-midterm conversation
storylines.detail: Moore won reelection and is drawing more attention as a possible 2028 contender. With no primary polling or decision to run in the evidence, the forecast assigns him only a small nomination chance.

storylines.title: Pritzker's new agenda adds to 2028 speculation
storylines.detail: After winning a third term, Pritzker released a national agenda and drew renewed attention as a possible presidential contender. The forecast gives him a small nomination chance while keeping most probability with the broader field.
